runs.classification_rationale: The retained raw IOS table proves ephone-7 was registered and the parser alone dropped it because its IP line was indented. The exact trusted phase-40 payload contains ephone 1 with a unique measured phone MAC, but all 33 raw registration samples omit ephone-1. The next experiment splits only independent BindPhoneToExtension mutations into one typed batch per action; it adds no retry, sleep, DHCP mutation, or policy change.

runs.classification_rationale: Twenty-one renderer batches with one typed phone binding each did not change the result: ephone-1 remained absent from all 35 raw samples while ephones 2-21 registered. The webview drains queued commands into one runCode batch, so renderer batch size alone does not establish mutation completion ordering. Batch size is refuted as sufficient. The next correction requires one exact ephone row readback to authorize the next binding and stops on absence without replay.

runs.classification_rationale: The ephone header correction closed the full canonical Floor1 Voice lifecycle: all 21 phones had authoritative access forwarding, IPv4, matching DHCP bindings, and SCCP registration. Floor1 then failed closed because Router0 and Router3 show ip protocols reads were pager-truncated and therefore unobservable; Router4 process state and all nine required RIP route expectations verified. This is an observer stop, not a RIP product contradiction. The next correction performs at most one additional read-only process query only when the first result proves executed, fresh, incomplete, pager-truncated, continuation-failed, and uniquely attributed; no control-plane mutation is retried.

runs.classification_rationale: Delta-only mutation preserved every previously verified Floor1 trunk, so cumulative replay receives causal credit for the prior old-trunk regression but was not the complete Floor2 cause. All four new non-forwarding interfaces were fresh, complete, uniquely attributed, trunking, and allowed/active for VLANs 10,20,30 at terminal trunk round 35. Sparse correlated PVST transitions moved every pending port from LIS to LRN under one retained root; none of those samples was blocked, and exact IOS output reported Forward Delay 15 seconds. The latest retained PVST samples occurred at rounds 23,31,33 rather than the terminal round, so convergence outliving the fixed boundary is strongly supported but not yet confirmed. The next gate retains one fresh PVST snapshot per pending device, refreshes the unchanged trunk predicate after that capture, and adds one 20-second continuation only when every pending field is authoritative and every expected VLAN port is LRN in that boundary snapshot.

runs.classification_rationale: The fresh Floor2 PVST boundary captured Switch6 and Switch10 pending ports in LRN and Switch7 already FWD; the immediately following atomic trunk refresh verified all nine trunks. The optional 20-second extension did not engage, confirming the former fixed-boundary defect and its state-based correction. Floor2 then passed all 75 cumulative Voice actions to mutation. It re-dispatched retained Floor1 binding 1 before any new Floor2 binding, and both permitted read-only readbacks failed pager continuation attribution while remaining executed, fresh, and uniquely attributed. No authoritative absence or product contradiction occurred. The next causal correction mutates only 28 new DN/binding actions plus the dependency-expanded phone-file action, retains 46 prior application facts, and still verifies all 35 phones cumulatively.

runs.classification_rationale: Voice delta-only mutation refuted cumulative Voice replay as sufficient: the run applied all 14 new DNs and reached new binding 22 without replaying any prior binding. The binding was dispatched once, but each binding still demanded its own global paged show ephone table. Both permitted reads were executed, fresh, and uniquely attributed, yet pager continuation lost transcript attribution after three and four pages. Neither read was complete, so no binding absence or mutation failure is established. The next correction dispatches the complete typed binding delta once and performs one grouped post-mutation table read that must simultaneously match every new index, extension, and MAC; cumulative registration still re-observes all 35 phones.

runs.classification_rationale: Grouping refuted per-binding query multiplicity as sufficient: all 14 new bindings were dispatched once before one shared logical table read, and later Voice phases remained blocked. Both permitted attempts failed at page three with rolled_unattributable while executed, fresh, and uniquely attributed; neither was complete and no row contradiction was claimed. Source algebra handles pager-tail rewrite when the transcript head is stable and head roll when the pager tail is stable, but not both in one transition: the erased --More-- remains inside the suffix candidate and destroys the retained overlap. The next correction anchors a rolled transcript against an exact line-bearing 512-byte-or-longer pre-marker suffix, forbids generic fallback after a recognized pager-tail mismatch, gives Python and the atomic JavaScript guard full CSI/syslog parity, and never counts syslog-only or transitional output as page progress.

runs.classification_rationale: The pre-marker transcript anchor completed the Floor2 grouped show ephone in one authoritative eight-page read, and Floor2 verified all 35 phones through FWD, IPv4, matching DHCP binding, and SCCP before checkpointing. Floor3 then verified its physical/configuration network foundation and dispatched the exact 16-binding Voice delta. One complete table contained only prior indices 1-35; all 16 new rows remained absent after one accepted reconciliation each, and the final complete table was identical. This is the authoritative design's documented Router4 mismatch—51 physical phones against max-ephones/max-dn 42—now reached in production. The 69-phone contract cannot be met on that design without qualifying and selecting a CME-capable Packet Tracer platform above 51 while preserving the branch topology.

runs.classification_rationale: The corrected normal production plan reached Floor3 with 232 devices and 160 links. All 42 Router4 phones then verified FWD, IPv4, matching DHCP binding, and SCCP registration, confirming the 42/20/7 rebalance. The retained three RIPv2 actions and all 12 RIPv2 observations remained verified. Before any new STP mutation, the fail-closed capability gate skipped 156 actions on 3560-24PS and one on 2960-24TT because stp_pvst_config has no exact-model live evidence. This is neither an STP product rejection nor an observer failure; the next bounded experiment qualifies that exact typed mutation and fresh STP readback on both models.
